items.usage: Position one or more axes rapidly for a non-cutting move.
items.notes: The axes can move independently at their rapid rates, so the path may not be a straight line. Verify clearance before every rapid.

items.usage: Move in a straight line to the commanded endpoint at the active feed rate.
items.notes: Feed interpretation depends on the active feed mode, units, and machine setup.

items.params: X Y Z I J K or R
items.usage: Move clockwise along an arc in the active plane to the commanded endpoint.
items.notes: The active plane is essential. I/J/K or R rules and full-circle support vary by control.

items.params: X Y Z I J K or R
items.usage: Move counterclockwise along an arc in the active plane to the commanded endpoint.
items.notes: The active plane is essential. I/J/K or R rules and full-circle support vary by control.
Address format and time units are controller-specific.

items.usage: Select or verify inch programming units for the active control.
items.notes: On Haas controls, G20 checks that Setting 9 is Inch; it does not convert stored coordinates. Other controls may behave differently.

items.usage: Select or verify metric programming units for the active control.
items.notes: On Haas controls, G21 checks that Setting 9 is Metric; it does not convert stored coordinates. Other controls may behave differently.

items.description: Machine-zero return through an optional intermediate point
items.usage: Return selected axes to machine zero, optionally through an intermediate point.
items.notes: Coordinates on the G28 block can create an intermediate move. Verify axis selection and clearance; G28 is not automatically a safe retract.

items.usage: Cancel active G41 or G42 cutter-radius compensation.
items.notes: Use a deliberate lead-out clear of the part before or while canceling compensation, following the control manual.
Left is defined relative to the programmed direction of travel.
Right is defined relative to the programmed direction of travel.

items.usage: Select the stored G54 work offset as the programmed part-zero reference.
items.notes: G54 selects stored values; it does not measure or set part zero. Work offsets and tool offsets are different.
Cycle words and retract behavior depend on the active modes and controller.
